title: EOF 方法自测｜南海海洋热浪 10 道选择题 / EOF Quiz: South China Sea Marine Heatwaves
summary: 中英文对照的 10 道单选题，结合南海真实 EOF 图学习距平、面积权重、PC、方差贡献和统计解释。 / Ten bilingual questions based on the South China Sea EOF results.
body:
【如何使用 / How to use】先阅读配图并完成 10 道单选题，再向下查看答案与解析。 / Study the figure and answer the ten single-choice questions before scrolling to the answer key.

【配图读法 / Figure guide】左图为 EOF 1，右图为 EOF 2，均由南海 1996—2025 年逐格点年海洋热浪天数计算。横轴为东经，经度；纵轴为北纬，纬度。红色代表正的空间载荷，蓝色代表负的空间载荷；色标单位为“PC 变化 1 个标准差对应的热浪天数距平（天）”。 / The left panel is EOF 1 and the right panel is EOF 2, calculated from annual marine-heatwave (MHW) days at each ocean grid cell during 1996–2025. The horizontal axis is longitude (°E), and the vertical axis is latitude (°N). Red and blue show positive and negative spatial loadings. The color scale is MHW-day anomaly in days per one standard deviation of the corresponding PC.

【第 1 题 / Question 1 · 分析对象 / Input】本专题做 EOF 的直接输入是什么？ / What is the direct input to the EOF analysis in this topic?

A. 某一天的卫星云图 / A satellite cloud image from a single day

B. 每个有效海洋格点在 1996—2025 年的年度海洋热浪天数 / Annual MHW days at each valid ocean grid cell from 1996 to 2025

C. 每年的海平面气压 / Annual sea-level air pressure

D. 2020 年的一次区域平均热浪事件 / One event in the 2020 area-mean series

【第 2 题 / Question 2 · 距平 / Anomaly】某格点 30 年平均每年 25 个热浪日，2024 年有 40 个热浪日。2024 年的距平是多少？ / A grid cell averages 25 MHW days per year over 30 years and has 40 days in 2024. What is its 2024 anomaly?

A. −15 天 / days　B. 0 天 / days　C. +15 天 / days　D. 40 天 / days

【第 3 题 / Question 3 · 数据矩阵 / Data matrix】把年份作为行、有效海洋格点作为列，EOF 输入矩阵的大小是什么？ / With years as rows and valid ocean grid cells as columns, what is the size of the EOF input matrix?

A. 30 × 5,529　B. 5,529 × 30 × 365　C. 88 × 100 × 365　D. 1 × 30

【第 4 题 / Question 4 · 面积权重 / Area weighting】等经纬度网格中使用 √cos(纬度) 权重，主要是为了什么？ / Why use a √cos(latitude) weight on a regular latitude–longitude grid?

A. 让所有海温升高 / To raise every sea-surface temperature

B. 减小格点实际面积随纬度变化对方差分解的影响 / To account for how grid-cell area changes with latitude in the variance decomposition

C. 把热浪事件长度统一改为 5 天 / To force every MHW event to last five days

D. 让 EOF 1 的贡献率必定超过 90% / To ensure EOF 1 explains more than 90% of the variance

【第 5 题 / Question 5 · 地图与 PC / Map and PC】某格点的 EOF 1 载荷为 +20 天 / 1σ PC，某年 PC1 = +1.5σ。只考虑 EOF 1，该格点的重建距平是多少？ / At one grid cell, the EOF 1 loading is +20 days per 1-SD PC. In a year with PC1 = +1.5 SD, what anomaly does EOF 1 alone reconstruct there?

A. +30 天 / days　B. +21.5 天 / days　C. −30 天 / days　D. 20 天 / days

【第 6 题 / Question 6 · 符号 / Sign】把同一模态的 EOF 空间图和 PC 同时乘以 −1，会怎样？ / What happens if both the EOF map and its matching PC are multiplied by −1?

A. 年热浪天数全部归零 / All annual MHW days become zero

B. 方差贡献翻倍 / The explained variance doubles

C. 重建场和方差贡献都不变 / The reconstruction and explained variance stay unchanged

D. 只有空间图不变 / Only the spatial map stays unchanged

【第 7 题 / Question 7 · 方差贡献 / Explained variance】EOF 1 和 EOF 2 分别解释 63.28% 和 9.31% 的面积加权方差。两者合计是多少？ / EOF 1 and EOF 2 explain 63.28% and 9.31% of area-weighted variance. What is their combined share?

A. 53.97%　B. 63.28%　C. 72.59%　D. 90.00%

【第 8 题 / Question 8 · 区域对照 / Regional contrast】EOF 2 空间图中某区域为蓝色负值，某年 PC2 也为负。只考虑 EOF 2，该区域的重建距平是什么符号？ / An area has a negative (blue) EOF 2 loading, and PC2 is also negative in a given year. What is the sign of its EOF-2-only reconstructed anomaly?

A. 正值 / Positive　B. 负值 / Negative　C. 必为零 / Exactly zero　D. 无法判断 / Cannot be determined

【第 9 题 / Question 9 · 动画 / Animation】网站的逐年 EOF 动画显示的是什么？ / What does the site's year-by-year EOF animation show?

A. 每天实际观测到的热浪边界 / Daily observed MHW boundaries

B. EOF 1 与 EOF 2 按当年 PC 加权相加的年热浪天数距平 / Annual MHW-day anomalies reconstructed by combining EOF 1 and EOF 2 with that year's PCs

C. 每日海洋内部温度剖面 / Daily subsurface temperature profiles

D. 海温超出第 90 百分位阈值的温差 / Temperature excess above the 90th-percentile threshold

【第 10 题 / Question 10 · 科学解释 / Scientific interpretation】EOF 1 解释 63.28% 的方差时，哪一项判断最可靠？ / EOF 1 explains 63.28% of the variance. Which statement is the most defensible?

A. 已证明 ENSO 是唯一成因 / ENSO has been proven to be the sole cause

B. 已证明全部海区每年都发生同一场事件 / Every location has been proven to share the same event every year

C. 已证明该时段趋势由人为气候变化造成 / The period's trend has been proven to be caused by human-driven climate change

D. 第一模态概括了最多的面积加权共变；成因和趋势仍需独立检验 / The first mode captures the largest share of area-weighted covariability; causes and trends need independent tests

—— 答案与解析 / Answer key and explanations：请作答后再看 / Read after answering ——

1．B。输入是逐格点、逐年的热浪天数；先由海表温度识别事件，再汇总年度指标。 / The input is annual MHW days at each grid cell. Events are first detected from sea-surface temperature and then summarized by year.

2．C。距平 = 该年数值 − 该格点多年平均 = 40 − 25 = +15 天。负距平不代表真实热浪天数为负。 / Anomaly = value in that year − the cell's long-term mean = 40 − 25 = +15 days. A negative anomaly does not mean a negative number of actual MHW days.

3．A。30 年是时间维，5,529 个有效海洋格点是空间维；完整的 88 × 100 网格还包含陆地或无效格点。 / There are 30 time samples and 5,529 valid ocean cells. The full 88 × 100 grid also includes land or invalid cells.

4．B。等经纬度格点的实际面积随纬度变化；√cosφ 权重用于面积加权 EOF，不会改变热浪事件定义。 / The area of a latitude–longitude grid cell varies with latitude. √cosφ provides area weighting in the EOF calculation; it does not alter event detection.

5．A。+20 天 / 1σ × +1.5σ = +30 天。这只是 EOF 1 的贡献，完整重建还包括其他保留模态。 / +20 days per SD × +1.5 SD = +30 days. This is EOF 1's contribution; a fuller reconstruction also includes other retained modes.

6．C。空间图与 PC 同时反号，其乘积不变，因此重建场和贡献率都不变；单独的符号没有固定物理意义。 / Reversing both signs leaves their product, reconstruction, and explained variance unchanged. The sign alone has no fixed physical meaning.

7．C。63.28% + 9.31% = 72.59%；其余约 27.41% 未由前两模态解释。 / 63.28% + 9.31% = 72.59%; about 27.41% remains outside the first two modes.

8．A。负的载荷 × 负的 PC = 正的重建距平。空间图必须与同一模态的 PC 一起读。 / A negative loading multiplied by a negative PC gives a positive reconstructed anomaly. Read the map together with its corresponding PC.

9．B。动画是年度统计重建，不是逐日观测，也不能读取某次事件的边界或持续时间。 / The animation is an annual statistical reconstruction, not daily observation; it cannot show an individual event's boundary or duration.

10．D。EOF 是统计共变的分解，不能独自证明物理成因。本地事件分析还用 1996—2025 年同时作为阈值基准与分析期，趋势归因需额外检验。 / EOF decomposes statistical covariability and does not establish a physical cause by itself. The local event study also uses 1996–2025 as both threshold baseline and analysis period, so trend attribution requires additional tests.

【延伸阅读 / Further reading】在资料目录中查看《南海海洋热浪｜EOF 空间模态和时间系数》和《南海海洋热浪｜EOF 逐年重建动画》。 / See the companion EOF spatial-modes article and annual reconstruction animation in the library. Method reference: NCAR Climate Data Guide, https://climatedataguide.ucar.edu/climate-tools/empirical-orthogonal-function-eof-analysis-and-rotated-eof-analysis .

title: 南海海洋热浪｜EOF 逐年重建动画（1996—2025） / South China Sea Marine Heatwaves: Annual EOF Reconstruction Animation (1996–2025)
summary:
播放真实 OISST 热浪天数计算出的前两 EOF 模态重建，看各年南海年热浪天数距平如何变化。
An animation of the first two EOF modes reconstructed from observed OISST-based heatwave days shows how annual anomalies vary across the basin.
body:
【动画是什么】上方动画由 E:/研究生课题 的逐格点年热浪天数计算。每帧对应一个年份，显示“PC1 × EOF1 空间图 + PC2 × EOF2 空间图”。它是前两模态的统计重建，不是卫星逐日观测画面，也不能用来寻找某一天的热浪边界。动画以 2024 年作为便于辨认的封面帧，随后按年份循环播放，2025 年之后回到 1996 年。
【What the animation shows】Each frame uses local annual marine-heatwave days for one year and displays PC1 × EOF1 map + PC2 × EOF2 map. It is a two-mode statistical reconstruction, not a daily satellite image, and it cannot locate a heatwave's boundary on a particular day. The cover frame is 2024 for legibility; playback cycles through years and returns from 2025 to 1996.

【颜色怎么读】每个海洋格点先以自己 1996—2025 年的 30 年平均热浪天数为零点。红色表示该年重建值高于该格点多年平均，蓝色表示低于平均，近白色表示接近零，浅灰绿色为陆地或无效格点。全动画使用固定的 −120 至 +120 天色标，便于各年比较。负色值是“距平偏少”，并不意味着真实热浪天数会是负数。
【Colour key】Each cell's zero is its own 1996–2025 average number of annual heatwave days. Red indicates a reconstructed value above that mean, blue indicates below, near-white is close to zero, and pale grey-green marks land or invalid cells. The fixed −120 to +120 day colour scale permits comparison among years. Negative anomalies mean fewer days than average; actual heatwave-day counts cannot be negative.

【与真实资料的关系】输入来自 NOAA OISST v2.1、0.25° 逐日海表温度经事件识别得到的逐格点年度热浪天数。研究海域为 0°—25°N、100°—122°E，1996—2025 年共 5,529 个有效海洋格点。EOF 1 解释 63.28% 的面积加权方差，EOF 2 解释 9.31%，两者合计 72.59%；其余约 27.41% 未在动画中重建。2024 年 PC1 为 +2.68 个标准差，所以这一帧呈现较明显的大范围正距平，但不能仅凭此推出单一物理原因。
【Relation to observed data】Input annual days come from event detection in NOAA OISST v2.1 daily 0.25° SST. The domain is 0°–25°N and 100°–122°E, with 5,529 valid ocean cells over 1996–2025. EOF 1 explains 63.28% of area-weighted variance and EOF 2 explains 9.31%, for 72.59% combined; approximately 27.41% is not reconstructed here. PC1 in 2024 is +2.68 standard deviations, producing a prominent widespread positive-anomaly frame, but it does not establish a single cause.

【应怎样使用】适合比较年际共同变化和区域对照，不适合判断单次事件的强度、持续日数或海洋内部温度。若要读完整事件定义和观测来源，可在资料目录搜索“观测资料、事件识别”；若要看前两模态高清静态图与 PC 说明，搜索“EOF 空间模态和时间系数”。
【Appropriate use】Compare shared year-to-year variation and regional contrasts. Do not use this animation to determine the intensity or duration of an individual event or subsurface ocean temperature. See the observation/event-detection and EOF spatial-mode entries for those concepts and the static maps.

【结论边界】此研究以 1996—2025 年同时作为热浪阈值基准期和分析期。动画仅描述这 30 年内部的相对变化；长期趋势和因果归因需另用固定基准、去趋势和独立资料检验。方法参考：NOAA OISST https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/products/optimum-interpolation-sst ；NCAR EOF https://climatedataguide.ucar.edu/climate-tools/empirical-orthogonal-function-eof-analysis-and-rotated-eof-analysis 。
【Limits】The same 1996–2025 period defines the heatwave threshold and serves as the analysis period. The animation describes relative changes within those 30 years. Long-term trends and causal attribution require a fixed baseline, detrending and independent evidence. The NOAA OISST and NCAR EOF method sources are linked above.

title: 南海海洋热浪｜EOF 空间模态和时间系数 / South China Sea Marine Heatwaves: EOF Spatial Modes and Principal Components
summary:
基于本地 30 年 × 5,529 个海洋格点的年热浪天数，图解 EOF 1、EOF 2 的空间图、方差贡献和 PC 读法。
Using annual heatwave days across 30 years and 5,529 ocean cells, this guide explains EOF 1 and 2 maps, explained variance and how to read their PCs.
body:
【EOF 分析的变量】这里对本地 analysis_results.mat 保存的逐格点“每年海洋热浪天数”做经验正交分解（EOF）。每个格点先减去自己在 1996—2025 年的 30 年均值，得到年热浪天数距平；把 30 年作为行、5,529 个有效海洋格点作为列。随后乘以 √cos(纬度)作面积权重，再做奇异值分解。没有把各格点除以其标准差，也没有去除长期线性趋势，因此属于面积加权的协方差型 EOF。
【EOF variable】This analysis applies empirical orthogonal functions (EOF) to annual marine-heatwave days at each grid cell saved in local analysis_results.mat. Each cell's 1996–2025 mean is subtracted to form an annual anomaly matrix with 30 years as rows and 5,529 valid ocean cells as columns. Multiplying each column by √cos(latitude) provides area weighting before singular-value decomposition. The cells are not standardized by their own standard deviations, and the long-term linear trend is not removed. This is an area-weighted covariance EOF.

【图像单位】上方两张地图分别是前两个 EOF 空间模态。PC 时间系数被标准化为标准差 1；地图色值的单位因此是“PC 增加 1 个标准差时，对应的年热浪天数距平（天）”。红色为正、蓝色为负。只看地图不能判断具体某一年的异常，必须同时看那一年的 PC 符号：PC 为正时按地图颜色读；PC 为负时正负相反。EOF 与 PC 整对同时反号，统计结果完全相同，因此模态的绝对符号没有物理意义。
【Map units】The maps above show the first two EOF spatial modes. Each principal component (PC) is standardized to unit standard deviation, so the map colour is the annual heatwave-day anomaly (days) associated with a one-standard-deviation increase in that PC. Red is positive and blue negative. A map alone does not give a particular year's anomaly: use that year's PC sign too. Reversing both an EOF map and its PC leaves the result unchanged, so a mode's absolute sign has no physical meaning.

【计算结果】EOF 1 解释 63.28% 的面积加权方差，海域内几乎全为同号，主要描述海盆范围的热浪年天数同步偏多或偏少。EOF 2 解释 9.31%，呈现南海北部与西南部等区域的正负对照。前两模态合计解释 72.59%，还有 27.41% 的加权方差留在更高阶模态与残差中。图中“方差贡献”是统计量，不能直接证明季风、ENSO 等某个驱动机制。
【Results】EOF 1 explains 63.28% of area-weighted variance and has nearly the same sign throughout the basin, summarizing widespread years with more or fewer heatwave days. EOF 2 explains 9.31% and contrasts regions including the northern and southwestern South China Sea. Together they explain 72.59%, leaving 27.41% in higher modes and residuals. Explained variance is a statistical measure and cannot by itself prove a monsoon, ENSO or other physical driver.

【数值自检】重算的 30 年逐格点均值图与本地原结果完全一致；逐年面积平均与原统计表的最大差异小于 10⁻¹⁰ 天；前三空间向量的正交误差约 10⁻¹⁵。这些检查支持数值实现与本地汇总的一致性，但不能替代对观测误差和物理机制的独立验证。
【Numerical checks】The recomputed 30-year mean map matches the local reference result exactly. The largest difference in area-mean annual values from the original summary table is below 10⁻¹⁰ days; the orthogonality error for the first three spatial vectors is about 10⁻¹⁵. These checks support consistency with the local summaries but do not independently verify observation error or physical causes.

【解释限制】区域边界、阈值基准期、面积权重、是否去趋势都会改变 EOF。此数据将 1996—2025 年同时用作事件阈值基准和分析时期，且 EOF 未去趋势，第一模态可能同时包含长期变化与极端年份共同影响；不要直接把它命名成某个物理驱动。
【Interpretation limits】EOF modes change with study boundaries, threshold baseline, area weighting and detrending choices. This analysis uses 1996–2025 both to set the event threshold and to analyse events, and the EOF is not detrended. EOF 1 may therefore combine long-term changes with unusual years; it should not be named after a physical driver without further tests.

方法来源：NCAR EOF 方法说明 https://climatedataguide.ucar.edu/climate-tools/empirical-orthogonal-function-eof-analysis-and-rotated-eof-analysis ；NOAA OISST 产品说明 https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/products/optimum-interpolation-sst 。
Method sources: NCAR EOF guide and NOAA OISST product description, linked above.

title: 南海海洋热浪｜观测资料、事件识别与统计口径 / South China Sea Marine Heatwaves: Observations, Event Detection and Metrics
summary:
用本地 NOAA OISST 1996—2025 年资料，解释海表温度观测、90 百分位热浪识别，以及强度和持续时间的正确读法。
Using local NOAA OISST data for 1996–2025, this guide explains sea-surface observations, 90th-percentile heatwave detection, intensity and duration.
body:
【研究资料】本专题使用本地 E:/研究生课题 的 NOAA OISST v2.1 南海逐日海表温度。研究范围为 0°—25°N、100°—122°E，网格间距 0.25°，时期为 1996—2025 年，共 30 个完整年份、5,529 个有效海洋格点。OISST 融合卫星和现场观测并插值到规则网格；一个有数值的格点，不代表该格点当天一定有原位仪器。它反映海表，不能单独说明热浪向海洋内部延伸多深。
【Research data】This topic uses local NOAA OISST v2.1 daily sea-surface temperature (SST) for the South China Sea, 0°–25°N and 100°–122°E, on a 0.25° grid from 1996 to 2025. It covers 30 full years and 5,529 valid ocean cells. OISST merges satellite and in-situ observations and interpolates them to a regular grid. A grid value does not imply an instrument was present there that day. SST alone does not reveal how far a heatwave extends below the surface.

【怎样识别热浪】本地分析先为每个格点、每个日历日建立季节气候平均态与第 90 百分位阈值：取目标日前后各 5 天构成 11 天样本窗，对气候态和阈值再作约 31 天的循环平滑。海温连续超过阈值至少 5 天才构成一次事件；两次合格事件若相隔不超过 2 天则合并。这是 Hobday 等（2016）定义的一种实现，阈值本身随季节变化。
【Event detection】For each cell and calendar day, the local analysis estimates a seasonal mean and 90th-percentile threshold using an 11-day window centred on the day (±5 days), followed by approximately 31-day cyclic smoothing. An event requires at least five consecutive days above the threshold. Two qualifying events separated by no more than two days are merged. This implements a version of the Hobday et al. (2016) definition, with a seasonally varying threshold.

【图像怎么读】上方原研究图显示 2020 年南海区域面积平均海温、季节气候态和第 90 百分位阈值。该区域平均序列中，2020 年 7 月 4 日至 10 月 1 日的一次事件持续 90 天，累积强度为 72.2 °C·day。它是一条“先空间平均再识别”的序列；不能把它当作每个格点都发生了同一场 90 天事件。
【How to read the figure】The original research figure above shows 2020 area-mean SST, seasonal climatology and the 90th-percentile threshold. In that area-mean series, an event from 4 July to 1 October 2020 lasted 90 days and had cumulative intensity of 72.2 °C·day. This series averages across space before identifying events; it does not mean every grid cell experienced the same 90-day event.

【四个常用指标】频次＝统计期内发生的合格事件数；持续时间＝事件从开始到结束的天数；平均强度＝事件期间海温相对同日历日季节气候平均态的平均异常（°C）；累积强度＝逐日温度异常求和（°C·day）。强度不是“超过 90 百分位阈值多少度”。空间覆盖率是某天发生热浪的有效海洋格点面积占比，也不等于强度。
【Four common metrics】Frequency is the number of qualifying events in the period. Duration is the number of days from an event's start to end. Mean intensity is the mean daily SST anomaly relative to the seasonal climatology during the event (°C). Cumulative intensity sums those daily anomalies (°C·day). Intensity is not the number of degrees above the 90th-percentile threshold. Spatial coverage is the area fraction of valid ocean cells in a heatwave on a given day; it is not intensity.

【可靠性边界】此处 1996—2025 年既是事件阈值基准期，也是分析期。结果可用于描述这 30 年内部的相对极端暖事件；对长期气候变化趋势和归因，不应仅凭该图下结论，还需更早的固定基准和独立资料敏感性分析。
【Reliability boundary】Here 1996–2025 is both the threshold baseline and analysis period. The results describe relatively extreme warm events within those 30 years. A long-term climate-change trend or cause cannot be inferred from this figure alone; a fixed earlier baseline and independent-data sensitivity tests are needed.
